name: GST Monthly
description: 74 GSTR-3B documents across five registrations. Haryana February 2026 has no ARN/date, so filing remains unverified. Telangana starts October 2025 in supplied records; other four start April 2025. Registration-state turnover is not customer-state revenue. Inter-branch taxable supplies may be included; no consolidation elimination is possible from 3B alone.
mExpression: let R=Json.Document(Binary.Decompress(Binary.FromText("",BinaryEncoding.Base64),Compression.GZip)), T=Table.FromRows(R,{"Month","GSTIN","Registration State","Taxable Sales","Exempt Sales","Zero Rated Sales","Non GST Sales","Total Outward Supplies","Output Tax","Net ITC","Late Fee","Interest Paid","Filed On","Source ID","Source","Filing Evidence"}), X=Table.TransformColumnTypes(T,{{"Month", type text},{"GSTIN", type text},{"Registration State", type text},{"Taxable Sales", type number},{"Exempt Sales", type number},{"Zero Rated Sales", type number},{"Non GST Sales", type number},{"Total Outward Supplies", type number},{"Output Tax", type number},{"Net ITC", type number},{"Late Fee", type number},{"Interest Paid", type number},{"Filed On", type text},{"Source ID", Int64.Type},{"Source", type text},{"Filing Evidence", type text}}) in X
